ValidationRule.description: Prevent conversion of Admin owned without changing the owner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Marketo Integration", IsConverted && Owner:User.FirstName = "Marketo" ) && Lead_Val_Bypass__c = False
